title: 负责任投资
summary: 评估金融机构将ESG因素纳入投资决策的程度，包括ESG整合、排除与尽责管理。

blocks.content: This document provides essential information on the components of the Responsible Investment Key Issue to enable users of ESG Ratings to understand how our outputs are determined. Responsible Investment is a Key Issue in the Social Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Companies are evaluated on their integration of environmental, social and governance considerations in the management of their own assets or the assets they manage on behalf of others. For additional details on the MSCI ESG Ratings Model, refer to Section 2, Data, ratings and scores, of “ESG Ratings Methodology.”
blocks.content_cn: 本文件介绍负责任投资关键议题各组成部分的核心信息，帮助 ESG 评级使用者理解评估结果的形成方式。负责任投资属于 MSCI ESG 评级模型社会支柱下的关键议题。公司评估涵盖管理自有资产或代他人管理资产时，如何纳入环境、社会和治理考量。有关 MSCI ESG 评级模型的更多信息，参见《ESG 评级方法论》第 2 节“数据、评级与得分”。

sections.title_en: Risks associated with this Key Issue
sections.title_cn: 与本关键议题相关的风险

blocks.content: \- Lower security values due to unmitigated or overlooked ESG risks.
blocks.content_cn: • 因 ESG 风险未得到缓解或被忽视而导致证券价值下降。

blocks.content: \- Client attrition due to mismanagement of investment risk.
blocks.content_cn: • 因投资风险管理不当而流失客户。

blocks.content: • Higher returns from ESG investments.
blocks.content_cn: • ESG 投资带来更高回报。

sections.title_cn: 负责任投资关键议题得分

blocks.content: The Responsible Investment Key Issue Score evaluates the company's level of exposure to, and management of, risks on this Key Issue. The Key Issue Score is based on the Exposure Score and the Management Score using the formula below. The Exposure Score and the Management Score are combined such that a higher level of exposure requires a higher level of demonstrated management capability in order to achieve the same overall Key Issue Score.
blocks.content_cn: 负责任投资关键议题得分评估公司对该议题风险的敞口程度及管理情况。该关键议题得分根据下述公式，基于风险敞口得分和管理得分计算。两项得分的结合方式意味着：风险敞口越高，公司就需要展现越强的管理能力，才能取得相同的总体关键议题得分。

blocks.content: Where:
blocks.content_cn: 其中：

blocks.content: \- $KI_{i}$ is the Key Issue Score for company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $KI_{i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的关键议题得分。

blocks.content: \- $EXP_{i}$ is the Exposure Score for company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $EXP_{i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的风险敞口得分。

blocks.content: \- $MGMT_{i}$ is the Management Score for company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $MGMT_{i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的管理得分。

blocks.content: The Responsible Investment Management score is based on the weighted average of the relevant indicator scores, modified by controversies. Default indicator weights may be adjusted for the relevance of business activities; an indicator has zero weight when the company has no exposure to the activity it covers.
blocks.content_cn: 管理得分按适用指标得分加权平均，再按争议事件调整。指标采用默认权重，并可根据公司业务活动的相关性调整；公司对某指标覆盖的业务活动没有敞口时，该指标权重为零。

blocks.content: $$MGMT_i = \sum_j Indicator\_Score_{j,i} \times Indicator\_Weight_{j,i}$$

MGMT_i denotes the Management score excluding controversies; j denotes an applicable indicator and i denotes the company. Component scores aggregate indicator scores using weights scaled within the component.
blocks.content_cn: MGMT_i为争议调整前的管理得分；j表示适用指标，i表示公司。组件得分按组件内重新归一化后的指标权重汇总，不应默认将各组件等权平均。

sections.title_en: • Dedicated ESG analysts responsible for analyzing ESG issues in investment process.
sections.title_cn: • 专职 ESG 分析师负责分析投资过程中的 ESG 问题。

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company has a dedicated individual or team responsible for analyzing ESG issues or if the company provides ESG training to investment analysts.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否有专职人员或团队分析 ESG 问题，或向投资分析师提供 ESG 培训。

sections.title_en: - Responsible investment policy to incorporate ESG considerations.
sections.title_cn: • 纳入 ESG 考量的负责任投资政策。

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company has policies and procedures addressing ESG considerations in the investment process.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否制定在投资过程中处理 ESG 考量的政策和程序。

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company is a signatory or participant in an eligible responsible investment initiative. Best practice is for the company to participate in or be a signatory to any of the following initiatives:
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否签署或参与符合条件的负责任投资倡议。最佳实践是参与或签署以下任一倡议：

blocks.content: \- Principles for Responsible Investment (PRI).
blocks.content_cn: • 负责任投资原则（PRI）。

blocks.content: \- Social Investment Forum (SIF).
blocks.content_cn: • 社会投资论坛（SIF）。

blocks.content: \- Institutional Investors Group on Climate Change (IIGCC).
blocks.content_cn: • 气候变化机构投资者组织（IIGCC）。

blocks.content: \- Investor Group on Climate Change (IGCC).
blocks.content_cn: • 气候变化投资者组织（IGCC）。

blocks.content: \- Investor Network on Climate Risk (INCR).
blocks.content_cn: • 气候风险投资者网络（INCR）。

blocks.content: \- Other responsible investing initiative (not including PRI, IGCC, IIGCC, INCR, or SIF).
blocks.content_cn: • 其他负责任投资倡议，不包括 PRI、IGCC、IIGCC、INCR 或 SIF。

sections.title_en: • Extent of ESG integration into relevant asset classes
sections.title_cn: • 相关资产类别的 ESG 整合程度

blocks.content: Definition: The extent to which ESG factors are integrated into the investment process for relevant asset classes. Best practice is for the company to integrate ESG factors into the investment process across all funds and investments for any asset classes relevant to the company:
blocks.content_cn: 定义：将 ESG 因素纳入相关资产类别投资过程的程度。最佳实践是在与公司相关的任何资产类别中，将 ESG 因素纳入所有基金和投资的投资过程：

blocks.content: \- Corporate fixed income
blocks.content_cn: • 企业固定收益

blocks.content: ○ Non-corporate fixed income
blocks.content_cn: ○ 非企业固定收益

blocks.content: \- Hedge funds and alternatives
blocks.content_cn: • 对冲基金及另类投资

blocks.content: \- Listed equity
blocks.content_cn: • 上市股票

blocks.content: \- Private equity
blocks.content_cn: • 私募股权

blocks.content: Real estate
blocks.content_cn: 房地产

sections.title_en: • Dedicated staff responsible for ESG engagement.
sections.title_cn: • 专职人员负责 ESG 尽责沟通。

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company has a dedicated individual or team responsible for monitoring and implementing its ESG engagement policies.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否有专职个人或团队负责监测及实施 ESG 尽责沟通政策。

blocks.content: \- Detailed engagement policy that addresses environmental, social and governance issues.
blocks.content_cn: • 涵盖环境、社会及治理问题的详细尽责沟通政策。

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company has a detailed engagement policy that addresses environmental, social and governance issues.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否制定涵盖环境、社会及治理问题的详细尽责沟通政策。

blocks.content: A controversy deduction ranging from 0 to 5 points is subtracted from the overall Management Score, based on the severity and type of controversies facing the company on this Key Issue. The following categories of controversies are used in the assessment:
blocks.content_cn: 根据公司在此关键议题上所涉争议的严重程度及类型，从总体管理得分中扣减 0—5 分。评估采用以下争议类别：

blocks.content: • Controversial investments.
blocks.content_cn: • 争议投资。

blocks.content: For more details on how controversies are included in the MSCI ESG Ratings model, refer to Section 3.3.2, Controversies cases, of "ESG Ratings Methodology."
blocks.content_cn: 关于争议如何纳入 MSCI ESG 评级模型的更多信息，参见《ESG 评级方法论》第 3.3.2 节“争议案例”。

blocks.content: The Business Segment Exposure Score of a business segment is based on a mapping of the business segment as disclosed by the company to a corresponding business activity. MSCI ESG Research uses the Standard Industrial Classification (SIC) system along with industry-specific adjustments to define business activities. The score associated with a business activity is used to calculate a Business Segment Exposure Score. Each business activity score is determined by a qualitative assessment of whether a business activity has a core involvement in asset management and investment activities (property and casualty insurance, life and health insurance, asset management, investment bank and brokerage, or other). Business activities where companies are
blocks.content_cn: 业务分部风险敞口得分以公司披露的业务分部与相应业务活动的映射关系为基础。MSCI ESG 研究使用标准行业分类（SIC）体系，并结合行业特定调整来界定业务活动。业务活动对应的得分用于计算业务分部风险敞口得分。各业务活动得分通过定性评估该活动是否以资产管理及投资为核心业务确定，包括财产与意外伤害保险、人寿与健康保险、资产管理、投资银行及经纪或其他业务。若该业务活动中的公司

blocks.content_cn: 管理自有投资资产、代表客户管理投资资产，或同时开展两者，则业务分部风险敞口得分较高。

blocks.content_cn: • $COM_{REI,i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的公司特定风险敞口得分。

blocks.content: \- $PP_{k,i}$ is the Portfolio percentage of company $i$ 's exposure to investment asset type $k$ (both proprietary and client investments)
blocks.content_cn: • $PP_{k,i}$ 为公司 $i$ 对投资资产类型 $k$ 的敞口占投资组合的比例，包括自营及客户投资。

blocks.content: \- $IAR_{k}$ is the investment asset type risk for asset type $k$
blocks.content_cn: • $IAR_{k}$ 为资产类型 $k$ 的投资资产类型风险。

blocks.content: \- $M_{k_{x,y,z},i}$ is a multiplier specific to the investment in asset type k by company i based on the factors x, y, z detailed below.
blocks.content_cn: • $M_{k_{x,y,z},i}$ 为公司 i 投资资产类型 k 的特定乘数，依据下文详述的 x、y、z 因素确定。

blocks.content: \- $x$ – Whether a majority of investments are in developed or emerging markets.
blocks.content_cn: • $x$：大部分投资位于发达市场还是新兴市场。

blocks.content: \- $y$ – Whether a majority of assets under management are proprietary, managed on behalf of clients, or hybrid.
blocks.content_cn: • $y$：大部分管理资产为自有、代客户管理，还是混合类型。

blocks.content: \- $z$ – Whether a majority of investments follow an active or passive investment strategy.
blocks.content_cn: • $z$：大部分投资遵循主动还是被动投资策略。

blocks.content: For companies where the breakdown of investment exposure by asset type is unknown, the Company-Specific Exposure Score is assigned as an industry-average score specific to the ESG Ratings industry of the company.
blocks.content_cn: 若未知公司按资产类型划分的投资敞口明细，则公司特定风险敞口得分采用其所属 ESG 评级行业的行业平均得分。

blocks.content: The multiplier $M_{k_{x,y,z,i}}$ has the effect of increasing the Company-Specific Exposure Scores from 0% to +40% on each asset type, based on the company's majority market, ownership of investment assets, and investment strategy.
blocks.content_cn: 乘数 $M_{k_{x,y,z,i}}$ 根据公司的主要投资市场、投资资产所有权及投资策略，使各资产类型的公司特定风险敞口得分增加 0% 至 +40%。

blocks.content: The investment asset type risk is evaluated by qualitative assessments of the liquidity risk, volatility risk and transaction cost for a given investment asset type. These factors are scored on a 0-10 scale, where a score of 10 indicates the highest risk and 0 indicates the lowest risk.
